notes.title: Legacy of Ashes – Demo 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to announce the release of [b]Demo 2.0[/b] for [i]Legacy of Ashes[/i]!
This version represents a major leap forward compared to the first demo, bringing the experience closer to the full game.[/p][h3]🔹 Key Changes and Improvements:[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Chapter 1 of the full game[/b] is now available to play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved gameplay mechanics[/b] for both combat and stealth, with deeper interaction with items and the environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Third-person view[/b] has been established as the main perspective for the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character redesign[/b] to better fit the game’s atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded menu options[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]Key binding for keyboard, mouse, and controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Display settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio settings.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Save & Load system[/b] to continue your progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added support for 11 languages[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]Arabic[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Italian[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]This demo is only the beginning… the island still hides many secrets.[/p][p]
We look forward to hearing your feedback and experiences![/p]
